display_name: Tri 融合正对自适应完整 11 设置 clean 对比
description: 11 设置各 3 种子，统一融合正对 RX 均衡，与原 Tri 和普通 PL 按物理样本配对。
authorization: 用户要求选四张 GPU 发布 11 设置各三种子与普通 PL 的完整对比。

data.physical_ids_ref: exact ordered physical IDs as both matched baselines
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 clean: cross_date, cross_rx and cross_both; only the latter two pooled

permissions.query_use: Same-row frozen E50 clean prediction followed by independent truth-last scoring
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed sample-adaptive candidate on 11 existing clean settings; no target-selected weights

checkpoint.initialization: same-setting, same-seed, same-contract original Tri E20 for new continuations
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: explicit known source-only ancestors, matching data roles and original recipe
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E50. Primary common rule uses U weight 6 and positive target mixture .5 for all rows.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU 0,4,5,6 only; max two total per GPU; min 12 GiB admission
execution.launch_command: python -m experiments.pamf_repl_source_adapt.full_suite publish --repo REPO --output OUTPUT --context CONTEXT --ssh-config CONFIG
execution.stop_rule: Stop new dispatch on blocking technical failure; retain healthy workers and all outputs.

expected_artifacts: 15 new real E20 no-query smokes and same-contract continuations
15 new frozen E50 raw clean predictions and independent scores
12 verified exact fusion-balance rows and 6 exact original-Tri identity rows
33 paired comparisons against original Tri and ordinary PL and an 11-setting summary

metric_names: source acceptance and affected fusion anchor fraction

rows.seed_notes: Only model seed varies. Source role split and other fixed seeds are bound by the matched protocol.

notes: Both methods use same setting, seed, physical clean records and fixed E50.
Preserve original Tri except the fusion positive target. The per-batch mix redistributes probability across supported RX.
Single- and two-source settings are exact identities: at most one alternative RX is available per anchor.
F2 U=3 is a previously replicated setting-specific reference, outside the common primary policy.
No checkpoint or coefficient selection uses target outputs. Existing clean targets are historically exposed.
